tasks.summary_en: Intersection of diagonals of parallelogram $ABCD$ (sum of coordinates)

The diagonals of this parallelogram intersect at the point: A. S=(-1+4sqrt2, 5-5sqrt2) B. S=(-2+sqrt2, 2-4sqrt2) C. S=(2+5sqrt2, 3-4sqrt2) D. S=(-2+2sqrt2, 5-2sqrt2)
tasks.notes: Sum of the point's x and y (the surd terms cancel to a rational sum).

tasks.summary_pl: Boki trójkątów: $1$ m do $5,9$ m, krok $10$ cm. Ile trójkątów?
tasks.summary_en: Triangle sides $1$ m to $5.9$ m, step $10$ cm. How many triangles?
tasks.statement_en: On the wall of a tenement house, a mural was designed made up of a series of equilateral triangles of various sizes. The smallest triangle has a side length of 1 m, and the side of each subsequent triangle is 10 cm longer than the side of the preceding triangle. The last triangle has a side length of 5.9 m. How many triangles does the mural show?

tasks.summary_pl: Pola ostrosłupów w stosunku 2:1. Stosunek objętości?
tasks.summary_en: Pyramid surface areas ratio 2:1. Volume ratio?
tasks.statement_en: The figures below show the nets of two pyramids. How many times is the volume of the pyramid with edge a greater than the volume of the pyramid with edge b? A. sqrt2 B. 2 C. 2sqrt2 D. 4

tasks.statement_en: A symmetric six-sided die is rolled six times. Let p_i denote the probability of rolling i dots on the i-th roll. Then: A. p6=1 B. p6=1/6 C. p3=0 D. p3=1/3

tasks.summary_pl: Rozpad jodu-131 (okres 8 dni). Ile dni do $\le0,125$ g?
tasks.summary_en: Decay of iodine-131 (half-life 8 days). Days until $\le0.125$ g?
tasks.statement_en: The half-life of an element is the time needed for 50% of it to remain from 100%. This means the amount remaining from each gram of the element after x half-life periods is given by the formula y=(1/2)^x. For the isotope iodine-131, the half-life is 8 days. Determine the smallest number of days after which no more than 0.125 g of this element remains from 1 g of 131-I.

tasks.summary_pl: Śr. prędkość $40$ km/h, potem $60$ km/h na równych odc. Razem?
tasks.summary_en: Avg speed $40$ km/h then $60$ km/h over equal legs. Overall?
tasks.statement_en: The value of the average speed is calculated as the ratio of distance to the time in which that distance was covered. A car traveled from town A to town C through town B, which is halfway between A and C. The average speed of the car on the route from A to B was 40 km/h, and from B to C - 60 km/h. Calculate the average speed of the car on the entire route from A to C.
